description: Public-domain Bible files bundled with Bible Presenter. The app offers to import these on first start. See LICENSES.md and docs/BIBLE_DATA.md.

bibles.name: King James Version
bibles.license: Public Domain outside the United Kingdom. In the UK the KJV is under perpetual Crown copyright (letters patent, administered by Cambridge University Press); UK churches should check the publisher's terms for projecting or streaming it.
bibles.source: https://github.com/seven1m/open-bibles (file eng-kjv.osis.xml, OSIS generated by eBible.org/Haiola)
bibles.notes: Default English Bible. Uses KJV verse numbering, identical to the bundled Louis Segond 1910, so every verse pairs one-to-one. Apocrypha in the file are skipped.

bibles.name: World English Bible
bibles.license: Public Domain. The World English Bible (WEB) text is dedicated to the public domain by its publisher, eBible.org. "World English Bible" is a trademark of eBible.org; this unchanged text may be called by that name.
bibles.notes: This edition uses the divine name "Yahweh" in the Old Testament. Deuterocanonical books in the file are skipped; the 66 Protestant books are imported. Optional alternative to the KJV.

bibles.name: Louis Segond 1910
bibles.license: Public Domain. Louis Segond 1910 (La Sainte Bible, version revue 1910) is in the public domain. The Beblia XML transcription is offered for use "at your own discretion, no need to ask for permission".
bibles.notes: Verse numbering in this transcription follows the common English (KJV-style) numbering, e.g. Psalm titles are part of verse 1, which keeps it aligned with the WEB. Some printed LSG editions number Psalm titles separately.
